item.title: Projection Mapped Face Sculpture for Festival Stages
item.description: A layer of hessian, then a mix of clay and papier-mâché, used to create these features. The build process of two video projection mapped face sculptures, designed, built, animated and mapped for music festival visual shows. By 1000 Errors, Bristol UK. Commissions and hire worldwide.
